Martha Fierro

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 29, Harris County, Texas · Challenger

Director of Texas Rotunda Prayer & Worship; bilingual minister; founder of the SheSpoke mentoring program

Martha Elena Fierro is a Houston Republican who works as a bilingual minister and is director of Texas Rotunda Prayer & Worship. She ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for the redrawn 29th Congressional District and won the nomination. She faces Democratic incumbent Sylvia Garcia in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Where Fierro stands

Economy and inflation
Calls for cutting federal spending to fight inflation and to lower gas, grocery and housing costs.
Public safety
Supports local safety initiatives, community programs and working with law enforcement to promote secure communities.
Health care
Supports lowering health care costs through competition, access, transparency and patient choice, rather than government mandates.
Education
Supports school choice and parental rights in education.
Energy and environment
Supports Texas control over energy decisions, oil and natural gas production, and efforts to make the power grid more reliable.
Immigration and border security
Supports Border Patrol and law enforcement efforts to stop illegal border crossings and human trafficking, including stronger enforcement and community resources.

Background

  • 2026: Republican nominee, U.S. House, Texas District 29 (advanced from the March 3, 2026 primary)
  • Former Republican nominee for Texas Senate District 6; lost to Democrat Carol Alvarado (about 37% to 63%)
  • Director, Texas Rotunda Prayer & Worship
  • Founder, SheSpoke mentoring program; bilingual minister
  • Previously worked in health care at the Texas Medical Center
  • Education: two degrees from the University of Houston; first-generation college graduate
  • Personal: Houston resident, raised in Texas; married with five children

Also running for U.S. Representative, District 29

  • Sylvia Garcia Democratic
